desc_group_action: Taking, granting, or losing actions, and basic actions bundled into a card's ability.
desc_group_aoo: Attacks of opportunity — provoking them, or avoiding them.
desc_group_attach: Attaching this card to an asset, enemy, or location.
desc_group_auto: Automatic results — auto-success or auto-evade with no skill test.
desc_group_buff: Buffing stats — swapping skills, an asset's stats, or your effective health/sanity.
desc_group_cancel: Canceling or preventing things — attacks, damage, horror, draws, effects.
desc_group_chaos: The chaos bag — revealing, sealing, predicting, and manipulating tokens.
desc_group_clue: Clues — discovering extra clues, or placing them.
desc_group_commit: Committing skill cards — to others, from outside your hand, fetching, or limits.
desc_group_condition: Conditional gates — effects that need a resource / sanity / hand-size threshold.
desc_group_cost: Ability costs — the price paid before the colon of an action / reaction / free ability.
desc_group_damage: Dealing damage — bonus damage, redirection, spread, and instead-of effects.
desc_group_deck: Your deck — drawing, searching, discarding, shuffling, and looking at the top.
desc_group_discard_pile: Getting cards back out of the discard pile (to hand, deck, or play).
desc_group_doom: Doom — adding, removing, or caring about doom.
desc_group_encounter: The encounter deck and encounter cards.
desc_group_enemy: Interacting with enemies — engaging, debuffing, mitigating, and their values.
desc_group_exile: Exile — removing a card from your collection on use (a campaign cost).
desc_group_gain: Gaining resources, moving them between players, or gaining keywords.
desc_group_hand_size: Maximum hand size, and effects that scale with cards in hand.
desc_group_heal: Healing damage or horror — from yourself, another investigator, an ally, or this card.
desc_group_location: Locations — movement, connections, shroud, clues, and your-location effects.
desc_group_multiclass: Payoffs that scale with how many classes you have access to.
desc_group_play_area: Moving cards into or out of play.
desc_group_recursion: Returning cards from the discard pile to play, hand, or deck.
desc_group_remote: Acting at a distance — investigate or move without being there.
desc_group_rfg: Removing a card from the game (one-shot, not recoverable).
desc_group_skill_commit: What happens when a skill card is committed.
desc_group_skill_test_condition: Effects gated on a skill test's result (success / failure / during an attack).
desc_group_skill_value: Caring about the margin you succeed or fail a test by.
desc_group_stats_mod: Modifying skill values — flat boosts, set bases, adding a stat, or substitutions.
desc_group_tank: Soaking for the team — redirecting attacks and encounter cards onto a card.
desc_group_test: Initiating tests, and effects keyed to performing them.
desc_group_testless: Testless effects — deal damage, evade, or discover clues with no skill test.
desc_group_timing: When an ability triggers — phases, skill steps, when / after windows, and forced.
desc_group_trait: Caring about card traits (Tome, Spell, Weapon, …).
desc_group_uses: Uses — starting charges/ammo/supplies/secrets, placing them, or accumulating tokens.
desc_tag_engage_effect: The card engages enemies as an effect — it makes one or more enemies engage you (or another investigator) via an ability, not the [Engage] action. The base engage effect; the with-you / with-you-multiple / with-another tags qualify who and how many.
desc_tag_test_difficulty_reduce: Reduces a skill test's difficulty (target number) directly — e.g. parley (Fine Clothes) or any test (Quick Learner) — as opposed to reducing a location's shroud (Flashlight). Both levers live together under the Difficulty Reduction compound.
desc_compound_thorns: Hurts enemies back when they attack or damage you — passive retaliation.
desc_compound_discard_self: Cards you discard from play (or as a cost) for a one-time burst of value.
desc_compound_support: Helps OTHER investigators, not just yourself — a non-selfish, team-oriented effect (healing others, sharing draws/searches, buffing allies).
desc_compound_clue_tech: Clue-finding technology: discover clues bypassing or easing the investigate test — discover-without-investigating, shroud reduction, or testless clues. (Extra clues on a SUCCESSFUL investigation is not clue-tech — see Investigate.)
desc_compound_shroud_reduction: Lowers the shroud value of locations, making them easier to investigate.
desc_compound_spend_resource: Spends resources as a cost — a payoff for a 'big money' economy.
desc_compound_attack_mitigation: Cancels or prevents an enemy attack outright.
desc_compound_succeed_by: Rewards succeeding a skill test by a margin (succeed by 2 or more, etc.).
desc_compound_fail_by: Cares about how much you failed a test by.
desc_compound_investigate: Rewards the investigate action — triggers off a successful investigation, or discovers EXTRA clues when you succeed (a bonus on a normal investigation, not teching around it).
desc_compound_enemy_field_control: Controls where enemies can be — pinning, blocking movement, or relocating them.
desc_compound_exile_package: Exile cards: one powerful use, then removed from your collection (an XP-repurchase deckbuilding theme).
desc_compound_into_play_cheat: Puts cards directly into play from hand/deck/discard, skipping the normal play action (and sometimes the cost).
desc_compound_deck_top_control: Divination — look at, reorder, predict, or choose what you (or the encounter deck) draw next.
desc_compound_bold_action: Bundles a basic action (Fight / Evade / Investigate / Parley / Resign) into the card's own ability, whichever action it is.
desc_compound_chaos_token_control: Plays with the chaos-bag draw: reveal more, ignore, cancel, predict, seal, or treat tokens as something else.
desc_compound_bless_curse_bag: Adds, removes, replaces, or seals Bless / Curse tokens in the chaos bag.
desc_compound_big_money: Cares about HAVING a large resource pool — converting resources into power or scaling with how many you hold. (Merely generating resources is Economy.)
desc_compound_evasion_package: The EVADE mechanic — auto/testless evade, mass evade, making evade easier, and after-evade payoffs. (Disengaging-and-fleeing without evading is Getaway.)
desc_compound_protector_tank: Take hits for the team — redirect enemy attacks and encounter cards onto a durable card, then ready it again.
desc_compound_fail_forward: Turns failure into upside, or softens it — payoffs for failing, retries, or canceling a failed test's effects.
desc_compound_discard_pile_value: Gets value back out of your discard pile — replay or recur cards from it.
desc_compound_action_compression: Do MORE PER ACTION — cheaper/free activations, an extra attack inside one action, or readying to act again. (Simply gaining extra actions is Extra Actions, not compression.)
desc_compound_multiclass_payoff: Rewards that scale with how many classes you have access to.
desc_compound_health_safety: Protects your HEALTH — extra effective health (soak items) plus damage healing.
desc_compound_sanity_safety: Protects your SANITY — extra effective sanity (soak items like Elder Sign Amulet) plus horror healing (e.g. Peter Sylvestre).
desc_compound_tome_support: Cards that care about the Tome trait — Tome support and Tome-only slots.
desc_compound_spell_support: Cards that care about the Spell trait — Spell support and Spell-only arcane slots.
desc_compound_relic_support: Cards that care about the Relic trait.
desc_compound_weapon_support: Supports Weapons (Firearm / Melee / Ranged) and Weapon-only slots.
desc_compound_item_support: Cards that care about the Item trait.
desc_compound_ally_support: Supports Ally assets and Ally-only slots.
desc_compound_insight_support: Cards that care about the Insight trait.
desc_compound_tactic_support: Cards that care about the Tactic trait.
desc_tag_condition_engaged_alone: Effect gated on the enemy being the ONLY one engaged with you (e.g. Machete).
desc_tag_stats_mod_boost_lasting_combat: A [combat] boost that lingers across tests for a duration (pair with a duration tag) — not a single-test boost, not an always-on passive.
desc_tag_stats_mod_boost_lasting_agility: An [agility] boost that lingers across tests for a duration (pair with a duration tag).
desc_tag_stats_mod_boost_lasting_intelle: An [intellect] boost that lingers across tests for a duration (pair with a duration tag).
desc_tag_stats_mod_boost_lasting_willpow: A [willpower] boost that lingers across tests for a duration (pair with a duration tag).
desc_tag_stats_mod_boost_lasting_any: A boost to a chosen skill that lingers across tests for a duration (e.g. Encyclopedia: +2 until end of phase).
desc_compound_firearm_support: Cards that care about the Firearm trait (e.g. refilling a Firearm's ammo).
desc_compound_melee_support: Cards that care about the Melee trait.
desc_compound_ranged_support: Cards that care about the Ranged trait.
desc_compound_healing: Restores damage or horror — on yourself, another investigator, an ally/asset, or this card itself.
desc_compound_passive_boost: An always-on (or condition-gated) skill boost while the card is in play — no per-test commitment needed.
desc_compound_cancel: Negates an incoming thing outright — an attack, damage, horror, a draw, a test result, a weakness, or another effect (a Diana Stanley payoff).
desc_compound_enemy_mitigation: Neutralizes an enemy WITHOUT a standard fight/evade test — discard it, defeat it, shuffle it back, or stop it attacking.
desc_compound_area_damage: Hits MULTIPLE enemies at once — all enemies at a location, a connecting location, or damage spread among them.
desc_compound_efficient_damage: More damage per action — bonus damage, an extra attack, or testless damage (action-compressed offense).
desc_compound_search: Digs through a deck (yours, another investigator's, the discard, encounter, or bonded) for a specific card.
desc_compound_economy: Generates resources, shares them, discounts costs, or puts cards into play skipping their normal cost.
desc_compound_clue_on_location: Cares about whether clues are ON a location — keyed to clue presence/absence, or dropping clues to set that up.
desc_compound_off_stat_combat: Fight with a non-[combat] stat, or evade with a non-[agility] stat (Mind over Matter, Mystic willpower-fighters).
desc_compound_extra_actions: Grants additional actions for the turn — MORE actions, not more per action (distinct from action compression).
desc_group_soak: Soak — assets (usually Allies) with 2+ printed health/sanity that absorb hits and can be healed.
desc_tag_soak_health: An asset (usually an Ally) with 2+ printed HEALTH: it can soak a hit without being defeated, and stays a valid target for damage-healing.
desc_tag_soak_sanity: An asset (usually an Ally) with 2+ printed SANITY: it can soak horror without being defeated, and stays a valid target for horror-healing.
desc_group_victory: Banking victory points — adding a card to the victory display.
desc_tag_cost_action_spend_charge: An [action] ability whose cost is spending a charge/ammo use-token from this card pool (every spend 1 ammo: Fight weapon).
desc_tag_cost_action_spend_supply: An [action] ability whose cost is spending a supply use-token from this card pool.
desc_tag_cost_free_spend_supply: Spend a supply use-token as the cost of a [free] triggered ability.
desc_tag_cost_free_horror_self: Take horror on yourself as the cost of a [free] triggered ability (the horror twin of cost-free-damage-self).
desc_tag_cost_reaction_spend_clue: Spend/place one of your OWN clues as a reaction cost — pay with progress rather than resources.
desc_tag_deck_look_investigator: Look at / reorder the top N cards of ANOTHER investigator deck (multiplayer deck smoothing).
desc_tag_deck_look_bottom: Move a looked-at card to the BOTTOM of the deck — draw-smoothing distinct from reordering on top.
desc_tag_evade_multiple: Evade ALL / each enemy engaged with you (or at your location) at once — mass evade.
desc_tag_engage_with_you_multiple: Engage MULTIPLE / any number of enemies at your location at once (mass-engage / tank pull).
desc_tag_enemy_trait_restriction: The effect is limited to enemies of a specified printed trait (Monster, Humanoid, …). Weakness and Elite are separate card-classification carve-outs, not traits.
desc_tag_enemy_target_exhausted: The effect only works on (or against) an EXHAUSTED enemy — the prey-on-exhausted / evade-then-kill affinity (Sneak Attack).
tag_skill_test_condition_successful_duri: Skill Test Condition Successful During An Evade
desc_tag_skill_test_condition_successful: Fires on a successful test performed during an EVADE — the sibling of successful-during-an-attack.
desc_tag_timing_after_evade_enemy: Reaction/play window after an enemy is evaded (you, or an enemy at your location) — the evade counterpart to after-engage.
tag_timing_after_play_card_of_trait: Timing After Play Card Of Trait
desc_tag_timing_after_play_card_of_trait: Trigger that fires after you play a card of a given trait (e.g. after you play a [[Spell]]).
desc_tag_timing_when_would_fail_test: Reactive window at the moment a test WOULD fail — a last-second boost can still flip it (Lucky!).
desc_tag_victory_display_self: The card adds ITSELF to the victory display, banking victory points (Delve Too Deep).
desc_compound_action_charge_cost: An [action] ability gated on spending a printed use-token (charge/ammo, supply, or secret) — the classic Uses (N): [action] spend 1 weapon/tool/spell engine.
desc_compound_self_harm_cost: Pay with your own health or sanity to activate an ability — power at the price of your body/mind.
desc_compound_multi_enemy: Deals with MULTIPLE enemies at once — area damage, mass evade, mass disengage, or mass engage (Dynamite Blast, Elusive, Cat Burglar).
desc_compound_getaway: Escape combat by disengaging and fleeing — leaving the enemies behind WITHOUT using the evade mechanic (Elusive, Cat Burglar).
desc_compound_combat_boost: Makes you better at FIGHTING — any [combat] (or any-skill) boost, whether in-test, passive, or lasting.
desc_compound_agility_boost: Makes you better at EVADING — any [agility] (or any-skill) boost, whether in-test, passive, or lasting.
desc_compound_intellect_boost: Makes you better at INVESTIGATING — any [intellect] (or any-skill) boost, whether in-test, passive, or lasting.
desc_compound_draw: Refills your hand — draw cards for yourself or another investigator (the Harvey Walters engine).
desc_compound_big_hand: Cares about how many cards are in your hand — scaling with, or raising, your hand size (Harvey Walters).
desc_compound_commit: The committing-skill-cards archetype — commit to others, from outside your hand, fetch skills, or add icons (Winifred Habbamock).
desc_tag_cost_reaction_spend_secret: Spend a secret use-token as the cost of a [reaction] triggered ability.
desc_tag_deck_draw_encounter: Voluntarily draw/resolve a card from the ENCOUNTER deck (Drawn to the Flame, Delve Too Deep).
desc_tag_enemy_blank_text: Blank an enemy’s text box (loses abilities/keywords; traits remain) — e.g. Mind Wipe.
desc_tag_enemy_ignore_keyword: Ignore a single enemy keyword (Retaliate / Aloof / Elusive / …) without blanking the whole card.
desc_tag_skill_double_icon: A skill card committing 2 matching icons — the strong basic-skill group (Overpower, Perception, Manual Dexterity, Guts, Unexpected Courage).
desc_tag_skill_wild_icon: A non-skill card carrying a WILD commit icon — you could commit it, but usually you’d rather use it.
desc_tag_testless_damage_evaded_enemy: Deal damage with no test to the enemy you just EVADED (only that one) — e.g. Blinding Light.
desc_compound_treachery_handling: Answers treacheries / encounter effects — cancel a revelation, discard a treachery in play, cancel an encounter draw or effect.
desc_compound_encounter_deck: Interacts with the ENCOUNTER deck — voluntarily drawing from it, looking, searching, discarding, shuffling, or choosing a revealed card.
desc_compound_chaos_token_downside: Suffers when a bad chaos symbol is revealed — the risk side of spell weapons (Shrivelling, Blinding Light).
desc_compound_doom_adding: Puts doom into play — power at the price of advancing the agenda (a Mystic staple).
desc_compound_self_harm_damage: Pay with your own HEALTH to activate an ability.
desc_compound_self_harm_horror: Pay with your own SANITY to activate an ability.
desc_compound_heal_damage: Removes DAMAGE — from you, another investigator, an ally/asset, or this card (Vincent Lee).
desc_compound_heal_horror: Removes HORROR — from you, another investigator, an ally/asset, or this card (Carolyn Fern).
desc_compound_conditional_passive_boost: An always-on boost that only applies to a specific action (Magnifying Glass: +1 [intellect] only when investigating).
desc_compound_exhausts: An ability that exhausts the card as its cost (action / reaction / free) — the broad exhaust-engine surface.
desc_compound_return_to_hand: The card returns itself from play to your hand — reusable, never hitting the discard (Opportunist, Try and Try Again).
desc_compound_player_deck_look: Look at / reorder the top of a player deck — yours or an ally’s.
desc_compound_keyword_suppression: Turns off an enemy’s abilities — blank its text, or ignore one keyword like Retaliate / Aloof / Elusive.
desc_tag_condition_clue_held: Gates/scales on how many clues YOU personally hold (Newspaper).
desc_tag_cost_free_spend_clue: Spend one of your own clues as the cost of a [free] triggered ability.
desc_tag_enemy_defeat_on_attack_success: Defeat an enemy as the payoff of a successful attack/test (a combat finisher).
desc_tag_testless_damage_engaged_enemy: Testless damage to ONLY the enemy that just became engaged with you (not all at your location).
desc_tag_deck_bonded: This card is Bonded: never deckbuilt, it lives set aside out of play and enters via its owner card (which carries Deck Search Bonded).
desc_tag_engage_target_engaged: Targets or conditions on an enemy ALREADY engaged with you (Flamethrower, Mano a Mano) — not forcing an engage.
desc_compound_difficulty_reduction: Every way to lower the effective difficulty (target number) of a test — a direct difficulty cut or a location's shroud reduction. The target-lowering counterpart to boosting your own skill value.
desc_tag_enemy_nonweakness: The effect only applies to non-weakness enemies. "Weakness" is a card designation, not a printed trait — kept separate from Enemy Trait Restriction (and from Elite).
desc_tag_buff_cannot_engage_you: Enemies cannot engage you — a lingering benefit ON YOU (the evasion-lock / Stealth buff), the sibling of "cannot attack you".
desc_tag_discard_treachery_in_play: Discard/remove a treachery already in play (threat-area cards, an in-play treachery). Removal, not a cancel — filed under discard, not the Cancel archetype.
desc_tag_cost_action_spend_ammo: An [action] whose cost is spending an AMMO use-token from this card (firearms). Split from cost-action-spend-charge, which is now charges only.
desc_tag_deck_look_place_bottom: Move a looked-at card to the bottom of its deck (NOT looking at the bottom). Accompanies a deck-look-* tag; shared by Alyssa Graham and Scroll of Secrets.
